title: Coding has become the easy part?
author: pikuray
selftext:
I have been working on my first AI project ever. It is an RPG game. I chose that because it's one of my favorite genre so it makes sense. 

But possibly the worst genre to make your first game in because RPG are more about feel than data. It's a lot of graphics, sounds, writing, worldbuilding. There's just so much many little things i took for granted. I think any adventure game is one of the most difficult thing you could do with AI because of that.

I think... Coding has become the easy and fun part???

I think i will keep working on my RPG on the backburner but i have to sacrifice the level of detail to something very simple-looking to finish in any reasonable time. 

I think as a beginner i should start with smaller scope games that don't require a lot of assets, like puzzle games, spreadsheet games, dating sims.
